site.title: Xero's package feed
site.tagline: Prebuilt Arch Linux packages I use or maintain, rebuilt automatically and served straight from GitHub.

repos.name: custom
repos.note: The general repo. Built by build-pacman-repo from pkgbuilds/ and served from a GitHub Release. It moved off GitHub Pages because a pushed file over 100 MB is refused outright, which capped what could live here and let superseded packages accumulate; release assets allow 2 GB and can be pruned.

repos.name: ghidra
repos.note: Stock Ghidra with the "would you like to analyze it now?" prompt moved to a tool option that ships disabled. About 500 MB, which is over GitHub's 100 MB push limit, so it is served from a release rather than Pages.

repos.name: orca
repos.note: OrcaSlicer, built from git. Around 164 MB, so it is served from a release for the same reason as [ghidra].
